metadata.description: Base name for all resources, e.g. "barber"
Container image (one image runs web + worker + jobs), e.g. <acr>.azurecr.io/barber-saas:<tag>
Public base URL of the app for this environment, e.g. https://app.example.com
App session signing secret (48+ random bytes). Stable across deploys — pass the value already in use, not a freshly generated one.
